title: A word counter
description:
Count words in a sentence with a table used as a dictionary.

```
Text? the cat and the hat and the bat
the 3
and 2
bat 1
cat 1
hat 1
```

starter.main.lua:
io.write("Text? ")
local text = io.read() or ""
local counts = {}
for word in text:lower():gmatch("%a+") do
  -- TODO
end

hints: Tables used as dictionaries have no order, so copy the words into a list and sort that (lesson 2.03).
`table.sort(words, function(a, b) if counts[a] ~= counts[b] then return counts[a] > counts[b] end return a < b end)`.
requirements: Print sorted by count (highest first), then alphabetically.
stretch: Skip short common words like `the`, `a` and `and`, kept in a set table.
